enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Snore. Murmur. Rub eyes. Turn again. Remain still.

Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth and spit. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Place bowl and spoon in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Brush hair. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone for time. See bus approaching. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music on phone. Check phone for messages. See bus stop. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional at hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Attend morning meeting. Examine patient 1. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records on computer. Talk to patient 1. Walk to patient 2's room. Examine patient 2. Draw blood sample. Send sample to lab. Talk to doctor about patient 2. Take lunch break. Eat lunch in cafeteria. Return to ward. Check on patient 3. Assist with procedure. Clean equipment. Talk to patient 3's family. Handover to next shift.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone for messages. See bus approaching. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Check phone for time. See bus stop. Get off bus. Walk to house. Open front door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables to pan. Stir vegetables. Add meat to pan. Cook meat and vegetables. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner with fork. Drink water. Place plate and fork in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Set air conditioner to 20 degrees. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Pick up remote control. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Browse internet. Type on keyboard. Watch a video on computer. Adjust air conditioner temperature. Turn off TV. Close computer. Turn off air conditioner. Lie down on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down on bed.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Remain still.
